text: Given a product_id that exists in Pax8's catalog, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called with valid credentials, Then the tool returns the Pax8 product record as JSON containing at least id, name, vendorName, shortDescription, sku

Given a product_id that does not exist in Pax8 (Pax8 returns 404), When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns the string "Error 404: <message>", not a raw exception or stack trace

Given Pax8 returns a 5xx error for a given product_id, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns "Error {status}: {message}" and that string never contains the caller's Pax8 access token

Given no Pax8 credentials are available for the current request (gateway mode with no X-Pax8-Token header, or env mode with PAX8_API_TOKEN unset), When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called, Then the tool returns the same "Error: No Pax8 token configured..." message the other 9 tools return, and Pax8 is never called

Given the tool's declared MCP schema, When a client omits the product_id argument on tools/call, Then the call is rejected as a parameter-validation error before any Pax8 API call is attempted (product_id has no default value)

Given two concurrent pax8_get_product calls arrive with two different X-Pax8-Token header values (gateway mode), When both are in flight at the same time, Then each call's outbound request to Pax8 carries only its own token, with no cross-request bleed

Given a real Pax8 partner account and a known product_id, When pax8_get_product(product_id) is called through the deployed INT connector, Then the returned id/name/vendorName/shortDescription/sku match the Pax8 partner portal for that product_id
steps: Obtain a real Pax8 partner API token and a known product_id (needs a real vendor account)
Call POST /mcp on the INT deployment with header X-Pax8-Token set, body tools/call pax8_get_product {"product_id": "<id>"}
Compare the returned id/name/vendorName/shortDescription/sku against the Pax8 partner portal for the same product_id
expect: Returned fields match the Pax8 partner portal exactly for that product_id
notes: Needs a real Pax8 vendor account/token, not available during design. Not a blocker for this ticket per the vendor-mcp track rule (a missing vendor test account never blocks).
